description: High-Yield Savings Account Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How much will your savings earn? A high-yield savings account pays more interest than most. You can add or take out money any time, but the rate can change. It adds interest at the rate you type, with the money you add each month. It does not know what rate a bank will pay. Real savings rates can change at any time. People ask for it as "high yield savings account calculator", "hysa calculator" or "savings interest calculator".

add.description: Money you add each month. US dollars. Default: 200.

n.description: How often interest is added. Your bank’s terms say which. Default: 365.

rate.description: Interest rate each year. A percent: 5 means 5%. Your bank’s rate. Treasury bills averaged 3.4%, 1928–2025. Default: 3.4.

start.description: Money in savings now. US dollars. Default: 10000.

years.description: How many years. In years. Default: 5.

name: project_savings_growth
title: High-Yield Savings Account Calculator
